decisive_items: Ziehl-Neelsen staining: Positive for acid-fast bacilli
Bilateral upper-zone and mid-zone parenchymal infiltrates with nodular lesions
Large areas of necrosis rimmed by epithelioid cell granulomas with occasional Langhans' multinucleated giant cells
response.rationale: R3 directly cites the definitive AFB stain plus chest imaging and histopathology, covering the full diagnostic chain. C1 is an append-only completion that adds descriptive wording but omits the chest radiograph span and introduces no new raw evidence, so R3 is the stronger raw-span-supported candidate.

rejected.why: Derived completion lacking the chest radiograph raw span; label embellishment does not add evidentiary weight.
